QuestInfo.name: [Chu Chu] Arcane Blockage
QuestInfo.0: Leaving the Vanishing Journey behind, you continue your quest to find the Black Mage. On the way, you encounter a mysterious object blocking your path further down the Arcane River.
QuestInfo.1: Leaving the Vanishing Journey behind, you continue your quest to find the Black Mage. On the way, you encounter a mysterious object blocking your path further down the Arcane River.
QuestInfo.2: Leaving the Vanishing Journey behind, you continue your quest to find the Black Mage. On the way, you encounter a mysterious object blocking your path further down the Arcane River. That object was actually Muto, a colossal Erda. Muto was mad with hunger and blocked the river such that no one could pass. You should ask the residents of Chu Chu Island how to deal with Muto.
